title: Sharp Summability on Supports of Prescribed Combinatorial Dimension
summary: We solve four questions raised by Bayart concerning coefficient summability for multilinear forms with prescribed supports. For every $m\ge 2$ and $d\in[1,m]$, we determine the product-summability exponent and the multilinear summability invariant: \[ \mathrm{prod}(m,d) =\min\left\{\frac{m}{d},\,m-\lceil d\rceil+1\right\}, \qquad γ_{\mathrm{mult}}(m,d) =\min\left\{m-\lceil d\rceil+1,\frac{2m}{d+1}\right\}. \] In particular, $γ_{\mathrm{mult}}(4,2)=8/3$, showing that the multilinear invariant need not be an integer.
